title: Ceasefire or collapse: Ukraine, November 2026
oneLine: Russia's offensive has stalled, the US wants a deal, and the gap is Donetsk: Moscow demands all of it, Kyiv says no land goes without a national vote.

whoIsWho.stance: No withdrawal from Donetsk without a referendum; needs Western money and weapons.
The rest of Donetsk first, then a ceasefire; talks continue, so does the war.
Brokering talks and wants a deal fast, with a 'free economic zone' on the table.

whyItMatters: The biggest war in Europe since 1945. Whatever line is drawn in Donetsk decides whether Ukraine keeps its strongest defences, and whether a ceasefire holds or only rearms both sides.

timeline.text: Russia annexes Crimea; Russian-backed fighters take parts of Donetsk and Luhansk.
Russia launches its full-scale invasion of Ukraine.
Russia claims to annex four Ukrainian regions, Donetsk among them.
A local ceasefire takes effect in Oleshky, planned to run to 1 November.
US-brokered technical talks expected in Abu Dhabi.
